d: Lonely place outside Naples. Seaside beach. Colle on one side, scattered with country messes that can be seen in the distance, and tents guarded by Gypsies. One troop of Gypsies is on the hill, another on the floor, all occupied at different offices. Zaida, Albazar, and then the Poet.
Don Geronio, indi Zingari and Zingare.
Fiorilla accompanied by various her Friends, like those who come back from a walk.
Elegantly furnished apartments in Don Geronio's house. Sofa, coffee table, chairs, etc. Fiorilla accompanied by Selim.
It is night. Sea beach, etc., as in the scene before. Selim's ship anchored. Gypsy camp illuminated. Gypsies, and Gypsies occupied at various offices, Zaida and Albazar.
Don Narciso and sayings, then Fiorilla disguised, and with her face covered in a veil, last Don Geronio.
Room in an inn. Small tables with lights, etc. Don Geronio and the Poet sitting, and drinking.
Don Geronio, turn to the poet, then Don Narciso in the background.
Room vaguely illuminated for dance party. Choir of Masks, Dancers and Dancers, Fiorilla, Don Narciso, then Zaida and Selim, last Don Geronio.
Don Geronio, turn to the poet.
Albazar, with porters coming to transport Selim's stuff.
Don Geronio and the Poet, then Albazar returning.
Piazza con casino di don Geronio. Fiorilla con Maschere, indi don Geronio.
Fiorilla, lead the Poet with a Exit.
Beach as in the first act. You can see on the anchor the ship of Selim, and Turkish sailors that are arranged at the departure. Fiorilla, ind Don Geronio with the Poet.
Selim, Zaida, chorus of Gypsies, Gypsies and Turks, indi Geronio, Fiorilla and Poet who return, last Narciso.
